scope: Every frozen snapshot.names entry beginning web/
timeBasis: startedAt is the first audit-owned artifact timestamp; initial AGENTS/snapshot and manual source reads occurred earlier in this same uninterrupted task. No exact earlier wall-clock timestamp was recorded.
authorization: Read-only complete web audit of frozen source. Latest user instruction overrides AGENTS three-clean-audit rule with one complete clean audit after fixes. This audit did not run the full suite.
methodology: Read current AGENTS.md and used only current rewrite source plus current tests. Did not read sibling/archive source or git history, and did not use earlier audit findings as evidence of correctness.

Parsed every frozen TS/TSX/MJS file using installed Oxc via pinned rolldown 1.2.15. Walked all AST nodes; extracted function spans, API requests, effects/dependencies, persistent storage, dangerous HTML/code evaluation, URL/src consumers, timers, async state paths and assertions. Reviewed the complete generated inventories; this is structural coverage, not a claim of line-by-line manual review for every file.

Parsed all eight CSS files with installed PostCSS 8.5.31, traversed declarations and media rules, reviewed visibility/overflow/position controls and external/executable CSS candidates; manually read responsive/usability sections. Reviewed HTML/configuration and documentation structure. Historical claims in web/VERIFICATION.md were not acceptance evidence.

Manually traced Workspace application composition and callback ownership, composer/default/model identity, project creation handoff, drafts and persistent operation receipts, current session/history, automatic schedules, provider configuration, MFA/login, navigation, usage and receipts; also selected mutation/ownership sections of workspace files, MCP, realtime, terminals, organization, settings and rendering. Per-file manual spans are distinguished in inspectionDetails.

Cross-checked model consumers against current src/runtime/providers.ts and settings/read against current src/runtime/extensions.ts. Composer and ThreadExecutionSettings have usable more-model callbacks; AutomationForm, ConfigSettings and the native ModelCatalog branch do not.

Ran four minimal local jsdom regression reproductions under .work with the pinned Node 24.22.1. Three tests ran together; the fourth ran by exact title filter. Fixtures use local fake catalogs and fake transport only, with no real credentials, paid inference, native runtime, external MCP, deployment or full suite.
Recomputed all scoped file SHA-256 values and whole-repository snapshot at completion.

findings.title: Model catalog consumers drop pagination, making later models and reasoning choices unreachable
findings.details: Workspace loads model/list in pages of 50. AutomationsPanel forwards only models.items, and AutomationForm renders these options without a cursor/loading/error/refresh or more-model control. A provider whose models begin on a later page cannot be selected within this dialog. ConfigSettings owns a separate 50-row usePaged but never exposes models.more, models.hasMore or model errors; a configured model on a later page has no available reasoning choices, and its configuration refresh button does not refresh this catalog. The native-provider ModelCatalog branch separately requests limit:100 with useResource and ignores nextCursor; discovery simply refreshes the first page, silently omitting model 101 onward. Server ManagedProviders.list actually paginates these catalogs, so this is a reachable response shape.
reproduction: Provide a model/list response with 50 Alpha models and nextCursor page-two; page two contains the only Beta model. Open Automations -> New -> model/mode settings. Only the default option plus 50 Alpha rows exist; no pagination control exists. No cursor request is sent.

Close automation, open composer model picker and click load more, then reopen the same automation draft. The Beta option appears. This proves the catalog entry is available from the same endpoint but inaccessible from the automation workflow itself.

For ConfigSettings, provide config.model=later/model_provider=beta and a first 50-row Alpha page plus cursor to Beta. The reasoning select contains only its default/clear option. Reload configuration reads settings again, but never requests the later model page.

For native ModelCatalog, provide 100 rows plus nextCursor providers:100 and a 101st model on the next page. No more control exists; clicking Discover models produces another cursorless first-page read and still omits model 101.
findings.expected: Expose paged catalog continuation and read/error state in every consumer, or use a shared bounded catalog owner that fetches the selected provider/model. Preserve current draft and provider identity while pages load.
findings.observed: All three affected consumers remain incomplete without an actionable explanation; automation only works around the omission by leaving the dialog and preloading composer pages.
findings.unaffected: Composer and ThreadExecutionSettings explicitly receive moreModels/onMoreModels and render load-more controls. Responses/Zhipu ModelCatalog rows sourced from provider.models are not affected by the native limit:100 branch.

findings.title: Effective configuration selects reasoning capabilities from the first same-named model across providers
findings.details: The model lookup compares only (model.model ?? model.id) to the configured model name. Managed model/list returns provider-tagged rows and may legitimately contain identical IDs from multiple providers. It therefore derives allowed reasoning efforts from whichever provider occurs first, ignoring config.model_provider and aliases. This is distinct from the pagination issue and reproduces with both rows in the first page.
reproduction: Return settings/read config={model:shared,model_provider:beta}, editableKeys including model_reasoning_effort and userVersion v1.
Return model/list rows Alpha/shared supporting high, then Beta/shared supporting max.
Open effective configuration. Its reasoning select offers high and does not offer max. Selecting high and saving sends settings/write changes=[{key:model_reasoning_effort,value:high}].
findings.expected: Resolve capabilities against the configured provider and model, supporting stable aliases and treating ambiguity/missing identity visibly. Never borrow effort options from a different provider.
findings.observed: The only valid Beta effort is not selectable, while the unrelated Alpha effort can be submitted. A real native/provider rejection would surface only after the incorrect UI-guided configuration write.
